{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, removing commas
# First, confirm there are no non-comma issues
print("Original revenue types:", df['revenue'].dtype)

df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Check the first few values after conversion
print("\nFirst few converted revenues:", df['revenue'].head())

# Now, filter for completed orders only
completed_df = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute total revenue from completed orders
total_revenue = completed_df['revenue'].sum()

# Print the result
print(f"\nTotal revenue from completed orders: {total_revenue}")"}
